title: Fsck
description: Result of `rebar fsck --output json`: {issues, fixed, issue_count}. Each issue has a `kind` (corrupt, corrupt_create, missing_create, snapshot_inconsistent, orphan_event, warn, push_pending, …) and a detail; per-ticket kinds also carry ticket_id (and filename). `fixed` lists auto-repaired items. Exit 0 = clean, 1 = issues (unchanged). The optional `returncode` carries that completed run's exit code as data (0 or 1) for structured surfaces (the library `fsck_report()` / MCP `fsck` tool); the CLI's own `--output json` payload omits it.

returncode.description: Exit code of the COMPLETED fsck run carried as data: 0 = clean, 1 = issues found. Optional — emitted by structured surfaces (library `fsck_report()`, MCP `fsck`), absent from the CLI's `--output json`.
